'''Wing 38''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] that fielded [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|Droid tri-fighters]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]]. The fighters were modified with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers.
